purpose: Vendor-neutral browser, accessibility-environment, Arabic/RTL, bidi, localized-input, reflow, visual-reference, and Unicode-risk evidence for external testing and research integrations.
nonClaims: Passing the controlled suite is not a WCAG certification.
Passing the suite does not prove linguistic correctness for every locale.
Passing the suite does not establish universal correctness on browsers, operating-system accessibility themes, or assistive technologies outside the tested matrix.
The Unicode risk corpus does not claim UAX #9 or UTS #39 conformance and is not a maliciousness-verdict dataset.
Provider-specific execution is not claimed until a provider integration is configured and observed.
